english.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial choice for someone or something free from burdens, worries, or obligations.

examples.english: Since moving out to live on my own, I feel unencumbered every day.
examples.traditional: 自從搬出嚟自己住，我每日都覺得冇負擔。
